title: Browser Use agents can now check out without ever seeing your card, with Evervault
summary: Evervault Browser Tokens let a Browser Use agent fill checkout forms with stand-in card numbers. Evervault swaps in the real card only in the request to the payment host you allow.
body_markdown:
Agents that buy things need a card. Giving a model your real card number is a bad idea.[Evervault](https://evervault.com/) fixes that.


With Evervault in front of a Browser Use browser, the agent types a token that looks exactly like a card: Luhn-valid, same length, same BIN, a CVV with the same number of digits. The checkout form accepts it. When the browser sends it to a host you allowed, Evervault swaps in the real card on the way out. The real number never reaches the model, the agent, or the browser.


## How it works


1. **Create tokens on your server.** Call Evervault's Browser Tokens API with the card and the hosts allowed to receive it. You get tokens plus a proxy login.
2. **Start a Browser Use browser on that proxy.** Pass the proxy login as` customProxy` and trust the Evervault CA. Every other site keeps full certificate checks.
3. **Give the agent the tokens.** It fills the checkout like a person would.
4. **Evervault swaps the real values** only in requests to the hosts you allowed. Tokens expire with their TTL.


```text
curl   https://api.browser-use.com/api/v4/browsers   \
-H   "X-Browser-Use-API-Key:   $BROWSER_USE_API_KEY  "   \
-H   "Content-Type: application/json"   \
-d   '{
"customProxy": {
"host": "us-va.browser.relay.evervault.app",
"port": 443,
"username": "PROXY_USERNAME",
"password": "PROXY_PASSWORD",
"caBundleUrl": "https://ca.evervault.com"
}
}'
```


## Built for real checkouts


- **Residential IPs still work.** Evervault can forward to the Browser Use residential proxy, so the merchant sees a normal residential exit: browser → Evervault → Browser Use proxy → merchant.
- **Switch only at the payment step.** Shop on the residential proxy, then change a running browser to Evervault when the agent reaches the payment form. Tabs and cookies stay.
- **EU too.** EU accounts use the EU Browser Use API and Evervault's EU relay.


## Try it


Read the[Evervault guide](https://docs.browser-use.com/cloud/tutorials/integrations/evervault) in our docs. Custom proxies are an enterprise feature: emailsales@browser-use.com . Browser Tokens are in preview at Evervault, so ask[Evervault](https://evervault.com/) for access.


Also see:[passwords with 1Password](https://browser-use.com/posts/browser-use-1password) and[paying with Stripe Link](https://browser-use.com/posts/pay-with-link) .
